scope: one common pre-target prior for every selected Method v1.1 cluster
derivation_rule: Use the complete development record before C0, including crossings, bounded zeroes, theorem closures, prior-art/status stops, timeouts, and protocol defects.
Round to increments of 0.05 while keeping every class strictly between zero and one.
Apply this vector uniformly at C1. No target metadata, selected identity, or post-C0 result may change it.
interpretation: The benchmark compares target-level selection forecasts against this deliberately conservative development baseline using multiclass Brier skill.
